name: optimal
description: Sports stats, game projections, and player projections for sports analysis and fantasy sports research. Compare player performance, explore projection percentiles and game win probabilities, and review historical stats with Optimal.

interface.longDescription:
Explore sports stats, game projections, and player projections with Optimal. Bring projected performance and historical results into your sports analysis and fantasy sports research.

Compare projected points, rebounds, assists, passing yards, rushing yards, and receiving yards. Explore percentile distributions to understand a player's range of outcomes. Study projected game scores, totals, scoring margins, and win probabilities.

Research fantasy sports projections using player stat forecasts, season game logs, and recent performance. Compare players for fantasy football and fantasy basketball, evaluate matchups, and explore upside for daily fantasy sports (DFS).

Find players and teams, check schedules and scores, and review team results across available NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, and WNBA games. Ask follow-up questions to connect player stats, game context, and projections in one conversation.
capabilities: Historical player stats and team records
